name: list_devices
description: The devices Drisp can put a screenshot on, each with the screenshot size in pixels that fills its screen exactly (portrait for phones, tablets and watches) and its page on drint.io.

name: device_mockup
description: Put a screenshot of an app or website on a device mockup and get a PNG. The screenshot fills the screen edge to edge (cropped to the screen's shape if its proportions differ: list_devices gives the exact size). Give the screenshot as screenshot_url (a public https link) or screenshot_base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB).

arguments.name: screenshot_url
arguments.desc: A public https link to the screenshot (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

arguments.name: screenshot_base64
arguments.desc: The screenshot itself, base64 (a data: URL is fine).

arguments.name: frame
arguments.desc: Frame colour: 0 the device's own (default), 1 the other of black / silver, 2 champagne gold, 3 midnight blue.

arguments.name: background
arguments.desc: "transparent" for a cut-out PNG, or a colour like "#ffffff". Leave it out for a soft studio grey.

arguments.name: size
arguments.desc: The square PNG's side in pixels (default 1024).
